about_the_game:
"Safe Hayven" is a new IP brought to you by Escape Code Games. Safe Hayven tells the story of Aya which is set in 2089.  The world is being dominated by the Z-54 A.I and Aya leads the "Rezistance" in fighting back against this new threat.

Taking place in a futuristic, cyberpunk version of the city Wrex (Wrexham), players will dodge and weave enemies whilst collecting fragments of data to beat Z-54.

Platform your way through server rooms, factories and cyberpunk city scapes. Shut down servers, open trap doors, laser barriers and fight A.I driven robots. Aya is making her way to the safe hayven where tech is obsolete and safe from Z-54!

Your health is regenerative, so be sure to dash out of the way if enemies catch you. Shoot them from the hip using Ayas "cybermod".

If you die, you can re-boot Aya's heart, but be warned, you will start the adventure from the beginning. This is to give a retro feel to the game, like back in the good 'ol days!

Safe Hayven is brought to you by a small team at Escape Code Games. The studio have worked hard to make a love letter to old school platformers with the added flare of new vision, storytelling and music.  

Enjoy a new journey, developed by passionate developers who love gaming as much as you do.

short_description: Safe Hayven tells the story of Aya in the city of Wrex, 2089.  The world is being dominated by the Z-54 A.I and Aya leads the "Rezistance" in fighting back against this new threat. This 2D pixel platformer with its killer soundtrack will take you on a cyberpunk journey into the future.
